system.attacks: 1 attack (butt, bite, or kick, by species)
system.description: Giant ants behave just like their smaller cousins. They wander all over the landscape, finding sources of ready food (grain warehouses, watering-holes, villages), communicate their finds to the nest, and set up a trail from the nest to the food and back. There are legends of giant ants mining gold, and there is a 30% chance that a lair will contain 1d10 thousand gp worth of nuggets. Terrain: Any except Arctic.
